instruction: Move all sofas from my amazon cart to wish list.
notes: The cart contents are only known at runtime, so the problem instantiates a representative cart with one sofa (sofa-item-1) and one non-sofa item (other-item-1); the real agent repeats the show_product/move pattern for every cart entry. show_cart reveals the cart entries, show_product reveals each entry's product_type (knowledge predicate known-type, required for all cart items before completion), and move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list is called without quantity so the full quantity moves. The goal demands that every sofa ends in the wish list and out of the cart while non-sofa items remain untouched in the cart, mirroring the evaluation's CartEntry/WishListEntry checks. Product objects are declared as domain constants because supervisor-complete-task's precondition must mention them.
